body_markdown:
GARLAND, TX (Nov 10, 2026) — The 2027 Warrior 1500XD and Sentinel 1500 HVAC Crew drew interest from dealers, fleet customers, upfitters and consumers throughout the 2026 SEMA Show. Digital content from Massimo's SEMA presence has passed 400,000 views.


9:00 AM


"Dealers see an opportunity to sell the products, while consumers were standing in our booth asking how they could buy them," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group. "At the same time, fleet operators and upfitters were looking at the vehicles from an entirely different perspective and identifying applications for their own markets."


During the show, Ron Luttrell, VP of Dealer Development, and Ryan Murphy, VP of Marketing and Growth, joined a Dealernews podcast on Massimo's dealer strategy and the 1500 Series. Massimo also took part in the GiveAShift industry roundtable on the future of powersports.
